body:
Hello, thank you for submitting this for consideration.

It appears that this is not a standalone license, because it is meant to be added on to the end of other licenses. Because of that, it would not be appropriate for inclusion on the main [SPDX License List](https://spdx.org/licenses).

I see that it has been submitted as an "exception," which I am interpreting as meaning that it is requested to be added to the [SPDX Exceptions List](https://spdx.org/licenses/exceptions-index.html). However, the Exceptions list is intended for things that "grant an exception to a license condition or additional permissions beyond those granted in a license."

The "156 Laws Exception" does not appear to grant an exception or additional permissions. Instead, it appears to impose additional _restrictions_, by requiring compliance with national laws. Because of that, it does not fit for inclusion on the Exceptions List. This is similar to the Commons Clause, which was recently decided not to be included on the Exceptions List for similar reasons (see https://github.com/spdx/license-list-XML/issues/902#issuecomment-625367262).
